# Update Access

Cursor has three update channels.

DefaultEarly AccessNightly

The default update channel with tested releases.

- Stable releases
- Bug fixes from pre-release testing
- Default for all users
- Only option for team users

Team and Enterprise accounts use Default mode.

## [Change update channel](https://cursor.com/docs/account/update-access\#change-update-channel)

1. **Open settings**: Press `Cmd+Shift+JCtrl+Shift+J`
2. **Go to Beta**: Select Beta in the sidebar
3. **Select channel**: Choose Default, Early Access, or Nightly

![Early access settings](https://cursor.com/docs-static/_next/image?url=%2Fdocs-static%2Fimages%2Faccount%2Fearly-access.png&w=1920&q=75&dpl=dpl_GncwoURS8Y1xqd6VWLEyZJaQzLkP)

Report Early Access issues on the [Forum](https://forum.cursor.com/).
